subject: Model mix & token volume follow-up / pricing confirmation
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: model mix + target economics (thanks for the demo)

Marissa / team —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As we discussed, procurement and engineering need a quick written confirmation of estimated unit economics to share with finance. Two asks from our side:

1) Example price range / $ per 1M tokens across the model mix you suggested (chat + embeddings + rerank) assuming predictable monthly volumes.
2) We can ballpark expected monthly token volumes, but want to confirm what we should plan for when evaluating costs.

Quick context: BrightLayer plans to start with a single product vertical and ramp to production over 6–9 months. Initial monthly traffic estimate (very rough): 1) chat interactive requests ~250k user sessions/month, avg 40 tokens in prompt and 200 tokens generated per session; 2) embeddings used for search & similarity ~3M calls/month at ~32 tokens/call; 3) rerank ~150k calls/month at ~20 tokens/call.

Can you validate those numbers and send a target $/1M tokens so I can run through finance? Also please include any guidance on model mix we should lock vs. leave flexible.

Best,
Amit
Director of Product 
BrightLayer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix + target economics (thanks for the demo)

Amit —

Great to chat — appreciate the detailed estimates, that helps a lot. Below is a quick written recap + conservative price ranges to share with finance. I attached a short spreadsheet (BrightLayer_pricing_prep_20261020.xlsx) that breaks the math out by model variant.

Summary (monthly):
- Chat (interactive generation)
  - Your estimate: 250k sessions/month
  - Avg tokens: 240/session (40 prompt + 200 gen) => ~60M tokens/month
  - Suggested model: redwood-chat-2 (cost/latency tradeoff) or redwood-chat-2-quant for lower cost if quality tolerances allow
  - Ballpark unit economics: $18–$30 per 1M tokens (depends on batch config & quantization)

- Embeddings (search & semantic match)
  - Your estimate: 3M calls/month @ 32 tokens => ~96M tokens/month
  - Suggested model: redwood-embed-1
  - Ballpark: $6–$12 per 1M tokens (embeddings typically cheaper per-token but consider storage/ops)

- Rerank
  - Your estimate: 150k calls/month @ 20 tokens => ~3M tokens/month
  - Suggested model: redwood-rerank-1 or run as lightweight cross-encoder
  - Ballpark: $12–$22 per 1M tokens

Estimated blended volume & cost (rough):
- Total tokens/month ~159M tokens
- Blended price range: ~$10–$20 per 1M tokens (weighted by model mix and choices above)

Key notes / levers:
- Quantization (e.g., 4-bit) can cut chat costs by ~30–45% at some quality tradeoffs. We can provide sample evals on your prompts to quantify quality delta.
- Batching & prefix caching are big wins for chat-heavy workloads; we can likely reduce effective cost per generated token by ~10–25% with config tuning.
- If finance wants a firm target $/1M tokens for budgeting, you can use $18/1M as a conservative figure for chat-heavy first-year plans; we can run a sensitivity sheet if you want a low/likely/high scenario.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm whether BrightLayer wants to assume conservative $18/1M (chat-weighted) for budget modeling.
2) Share any hard constraints on model choices (e.g., must use quantized variants, or must use lowest-latency instances).
3) If you want, schedule a 30-min pricing review w/ Rishi and me — we can run the spreadsheet live and map to Dedicated vs Hosted options.

I've attached Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf with typical SLA/pricing tiers and included a HubSpot link for the deal.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Amit Shah <amit@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@brightlayer.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix + target economics (thanks for the demo)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clear summary — this is exactly what finance needed. Quick answers from our side after an internal sync:

- Model mix (initial year): chat 70%, embeddings 25%, rerank 5% (we expect embeddings to grow over time as search expands)
- Monthly target volumes (confirmed):
  - Chat: ~60M tokens/month (your calc matches ours)
  - Embeddings: ~100M tokens/month
  - Rerank: ~5M tokens/month
- Budget guidance: finance is comfortable planning at $16/1M tokens as a mid-case. They asked for worst-case at $22/1M and best-case at $12/1M for sensitivity testing.
- Constraints: We prefer to keep model variants flexible but would like to prioritize cost reductions via quantization and batching. Low-latency hard constraints only for a small subset (pilot users).

Can we do the 30-min pricing review tomorrow at 10am PT? If that works, please send calendar invite.

Appreciate it —
Amit
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix + target economics (thanks for the demo)

Amit —

Perfect — thanks for the confirmation and the budget bands. 10am PT tomorrow works for Rishi and me; I just sent a calendar invite (HubSpot: Deal DL-8342). Agenda: 1) walk through the attached spreadsheet numbers, 2) show sensitivity (12/16/22 $ per 1M scenarios), 3) discuss Dedicated vs Hosted breakeven for your volumes.

Action items I will own before the call:
- Rishi: add a Dedicated capacity estimate and monthly commitment options to the spreadsheet.
- Me: prepare sample evals for chat quantized vs full precision on your top 5 templates (we'll show quality delta and token cost impact).

Attachments referenced: BrightLayer_pricing_prep_20261020.xlsx, Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf

See you tomorrow —
Marissa
